title: Validate browser evidence bytes
responsibility: Accept only supported, intact evidence media and explain refused content.

inputs.name: browserArtifact.media
inputs.description: Bytes and exact declared media type; only the supported evidence media-type list is accepted.

inputs.name: browserArtifact.sha256
inputs.description: Expected SHA-256 of the requested artifact.

outputs.name: browserArtifact
outputs.description: Validated artifact from the hosted-artifact reader.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsupported kinds, mismatched SHA-256, oversized files or failed media validation; size and unsupported-type messages are rewritten for the browser.
